title: New law officers appointed in Karnataka following change in administration
description: The Karnataka government has appointed a new set of law officers to represent the State before the courts following the recent change in administration.Advocate BN Jagadeesh has been promoted and appointed as State Public Prosecutor-I, replacing BA Belliyappa.
